reason: Load the active backend contract index before changing the cross-layer daemon and CLI runtime.

Place the shared wire server, broker adapter, bridge and CLI boundaries in the existing crate ownership layout.
Add only compatible IDs, fields, message kinds and conversions with stable bounds, redaction and error projection.
Route every public command through the same-UID daemon while preserving strict unary and bounded duplex framing semantics.
Keep Session, PTY, attachment, controller, replay and resource truth in the one transport-independent SessionService.
Use authenticated normal-ALPN service streams, ConnectionDemand and generation-aware commit permits without widening Endpoint ownership.
Resolve device direction and implement identity reset through exact UserPaths, StoreActor and lifecycle ownership.
Ensure stream loss, detach, revoke and CLI exit never gain authority to close or signal a persistent PTY.

Render authoritative snapshots and continuous deltas with bounded visible-grid checkpoints and no raw escape replay.
Project target, transport, authorization, Session, lease, sync and outcome-unknown failures into stable typed CLI diagnostics.
Keep tickets, terminal bytes, cwd, direct addresses and route data out of logs, Debug and error surfaces.
Apply focused deterministic tests, full quality gates and proportionate Linux real-Iroh evidence.
Start from the inspected M4 and M5-M6 APIs, identified adapter seams and explicit forbidden shortcuts.
Preserve the exact M4 SessionService, local IPC, replay, attachment and PTY ownership handoff.
Preserve the exact M5-M6 broker, service-stream, authorization and lifecycle handoff into M7.
Maintain one normal connection per device pair with independent bounded streams for multiple Sessions.
Make local and remote views attach the same Session with no implicit local controller priority.
Keep persistence generic to shell Sessions and independent of connection, CLI and named agent programs.
Implement snapshot-first reconnect, revision continuity and input suppression during synchronization.
Enforce durable revoke and generation fairness while preserving host Session and PTY state.
Keep pairing as honest host-user trust and avoid inventing unsupported per-session isolation.
Honor the confirmed one-Session-per-CLI command surface and leave embedded tabs and mobile UI deferred.
